mapper.select: SELECT FLOOR(stars) as rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} GROUP BY FLOOR(stars) ORDER BY rating

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(review_date, '%Y-%m') as period, AVG(stars) as avg_rating, COUNT(*) as review_count FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(review_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId}
SELECT review_id, user_id, business_id, stars, useful, funny, cool, text, review_date, created_at FROM reviews ORDER BY review_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
